transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Slow your steps, boy. The stone carries every sound to the well.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm searching for my brother Omar. The well dragged him down here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Then guilt has sharp teeth, for it has driven you far. Tell me what foolish dare brought him here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I dared him to insult the well. Now please tell me how to reach him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Paths below this stone are not given freely. The King of Jinn hears careless hearts.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me how to survive. I just need enough strength to reach Omar.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There are words that steady a man before the King. They are not spoken lightly.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: If you tell me those words, I will give you gold when we get out.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Gold has no weight in a place that eats memory. Sacred things are not traded.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then I'll bring you food and water from the surface.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Food spoils and water dries. Sacred words do not bend for hunger.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I can help you escape this place. Just tell me the prayer.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Forty years have passed and still you think escape is a bargain. The well does not trade prisoners.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then I'll owe you my life. I will serve you forever.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: A life promised in panic is worth little. Sacred words are not bought with desperate vows.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Alright, listen. I will bring you ten men to guard you.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: More footsteps only feed the well. You offer gifts that make this place stronger.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then tell me what you want. There must be something.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: What I want cannot be traded. I want the years the well swallowed.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I swear I'll honor you. People will know your name.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Names fade quickly here. Mine has already begun to thin.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then at least tell me the first word of the prayer.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Sacred words are not broken into pieces. A thief's request is still theft.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then whisper it so only I can hear.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Whispers travel farther than shouts in this place. I will not risk it.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: You're letting my brother suffer because you won't help.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Your brother fell because of your dare, not my silence. Do not move your guilt onto me.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: So there's nothing I can offer you?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Nothing you carry has value here. You have tried gold, promises, and vows — sacred words are given only to those who deserve them. Leave now, Salim, for I will not give you the prayer.
